title: Working with Databases (MongoDB or SQL)
description: Learn how to connect your Node.js applications to databases. This module covers both NoSQL databases like MongoDB and SQL databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL, teaching you how to store, retrieve, and manipulate data efficiently.

lessons.title: Introduction to Databases
lessons.content: Understand the basics of databases, the difference between SQL and NoSQL, and why databases are essential for persistent data storage in web applications.

lessons.title: Setting Up MongoDB with Node.js
lessons.content: Learn how to install and set up MongoDB locally or use cloud services like MongoDB Atlas. Discover how to connect your Node.js app to MongoDB using Mongoose, a popular ODM library.

lessons.title: CRUD Operations with MongoDB
lessons.content: Master creating, reading, updating, and deleting documents in MongoDB. You will write code to handle common data operations using Mongoose models and queries.

lessons.title: Introduction to SQL Databases
lessons.content: Learn about relational databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL. Understand tables, rows, columns, relationships, and how SQL queries work.

lessons.title: Connecting Node.js with MySQL/PostgreSQL
lessons.content: Explore how to connect your Node.js application to SQL databases using libraries like 'mysql2' or 'pg'. Learn how to execute SQL queries and handle results.

lessons.title: Performing CRUD with SQL
lessons.content: Write SQL commands for creating, reading, updating, and deleting data. Learn how to use Node.js to perform these operations safely using prepared statements.

lessons.title: Database Schema Design and Relationships
lessons.content: Understand how to design effective database schemas, normalize data, and define relationships like one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-many.

lessons.title: Using ORMs: Sequelize and Mongoose
lessons.content: Learn about Object Relational Mappers (ORMs) like Sequelize for SQL and Mongoose for MongoDB. Understand how they simplify database operations and schema management.

lessons.title: Handling Database Errors and Transactions
lessons.content: Explore common database errors and how to handle them gracefully. Understand transactions, rollbacks, and ensuring data integrity during complex operations.

lessons.title: Optimizing Database Performance
lessons.content: Learn techniques for improving database performance such as indexing, query optimization, connection pooling, and caching strategies.
